items.description: The report does not state a concrete observable for 'retrievable via executeWithdrawal or cancelWithdrawal' beyond the qualitative locked/not-locked outcome; the retrievability relation is represented as a grounded Boolean rather than a numeric or state-correspondence relation.

The report states the loss of access is potential and conditional on absence of complex manual owner intervention; the required_effect template cannot express the potential/conditional modality of the impact, so the impact is represented only as a separate observable symbol rather than asserted as certain.

The report does not define a numeric or structural observable for 'stuck' beyond the qualitative Boolean; the direct V is represented as the negation of retrievability, which is a qualitative restatement rather than a measured state.
